title: Status-update replies from a fresh Assistant conversation reach the phone, and Mac load alerts stop counting as TJ at the laptop

fields.why: TJ's Status update button (13 Nov 14:46 UTC) got no reply on the phone

text: Bridge log ~/Library/Logs/Genlock/phone-bridge.log: 'phone said Status update' 14:46:38, no reply line. Tally answered at 14:48:02 in fresh conversation 72ccc36b (Assistant transcripts in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tj-Library-Application-Support-Genlock-Assistant); next fresh one cea11119 at 14:49. TranscriptFollower (mobile/bridge/lib.mjs) never followed 72ccc36b; suspect findAssistant's sessions.json/state.json lag after AppModel.startAssistantFreshIfDue. Also promptSource counts '[Load alert]' as laptop: walk:false and it moves the mark.
